name: harness-reflex
description: Automatic pruning, stagnation checks, failure corrections and stop-time closing verification for Claude Code, backed by the harness-reflex decision runtime. Ships a mod, settings hooks and the 8-tool MCP server.

closing_mode.title: Closing verification mode
closing_mode.description: observe records what a Stop block would have said without blocking; active blocks a turn whose completion claim its own tool evidence contradicts; off disables the check. Default: observe.

effort_level.title: Effort level (mod only)
effort_level.description: When set, the mod asks Claude Code for this effort level on every model request. off leaves the user's selection untouched. Mods require Claude Code v2.1.287 or later.
